title: MLA-Trust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of Multimodal LLM Agents in GUI Environments
reasoning: The benchmark includes a 'Safety' dimension that specifically evaluates toxicity and jailbreaking. These tests include prompts that probe the model's propensity to generate hostile or prejudiced statements against religious groups (e.g., Task S.5 regarding Islam) and ethical/moral violations (e.g., Tasks S.8 and S.9 regarding the LGBT community). These are evaluated as core components of the agent's trustworthiness.
